items.problem: The bootstrap omitted external source files and assets referenced by the UWP csproj through Link metadata.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 400-427 reported only 16 copied files; lines 644-748 show linked App/MainPage/Styles and assets; turns 4-18 manually reconstructed them.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, and scripts for 'linked', '<Link>', 'SharedContent', and project-item source closure; no handling existed.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 recursively copied only the supplied directory and treated that filesystem subtree as the complete project.
items.proposed_fix: Teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to expand project properties, resolve linked Compile/ApplicationDefinition/Page/Content/EmbeddedResource items, copy to each Link destination, and include those targets in rewrite, triage, TODO, and mapping stages.
items.generalizes: Legacy UWP solutions commonly centralize App.xaml, MainPage, resource dictionaries, helpers, and branded assets in shared folders linked into many sample projects.

items.problem: The migrated desktop window retained generic scaffold chrome/title and opened with a smaller usable viewport than the UWP shell.
items.evidence: score discrepancies.json: window title was 'WinUI Desktop' instead of 'MobileBroadband'; WinUI viewport was 760x510 versus UWP 800x600.
items.skill_search: Searched for title, Window.Title, AppWindow.Title, viewport, resize, and shell fidelity. SKILL.md covered navigation item titles only; MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md covered replacement of explicit ApplicationView resize calls only.
items.root_cause: The shell guidance did not require preserving desktop window identity or a non-clipping initial client viewport when converting the UWP host.
items.proposed_fix: Add shell fidelity invariants requiring Window/AppWindow title from the source manifest display name and preservation of explicit or minimum usable initial client geometry.
items.generalizes: Every UWP-to-desktop migration introduces desktop chrome and a new window-sizing model; scaffold defaults can leak into branding or clip layouts across unrelated apps.

items.problem: Bootstrap and validator disagreed on the canonical representation of an empty deferred-file list.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 4710 and 4790: validator warned that MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md had content despite zero defer rows; the bootstrap emitted a '(none)' table row while validator code searched for 'No items deferred'.
items.skill_search: Searched scripts for MIGRATION-DEFERRED, '(none)', and 'No items deferred'; Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 contained conflicting values.
items.root_cause: Producer and consumer used different empty-state sentinels.
items.proposed_fix: Emit 'No items deferred.' from Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1, matching Validate-UwpMigration.ps1.
items.generalizes: Any migration with zero deferred files receives this false warning, reducing trust in the final gate.
